name: io.github.ianderso/polish-archives-mcp
title: Polish Archives Indexes
description: Search Geneteka, the Poznań Project and BaSIA for Polish vital records; fetch archive scans.

environmentVariables.name: POLISH_ARCHIVES_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the on-disk response cache.

environmentVariables.name: POLISH_ARCHIVES_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: HTTP timeout in seconds for one request. Scan downloads get 180 s to read.

environmentVariables.name: POLISH_ARCHIVES_MIN_INTERVAL
environmentVariables.description: Least seconds between two requests to one site. Never below 4; BaSIA always gets at least 10.

environmentVariables.name: POLISH_ARCHIVES_CONTACT
environmentVariables.description: An email address or URL appended to the User-Agent, so a site can reach whoever runs the server.

environmentVariables.name: POLISH_ARCHIVES_DOWNLOAD_DIR
environmentVariables.description: An existing folder. When set, swa_scan saves only inside it; needed to save under ~/Library, such as an iCloud Drive folder.
